+def load_image(image_path: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Load inline images or storage objects without fetching user-provided URLs."""
+    if not image_path:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if image_path.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, encoded = image_path.split(",", 1)
+            if not header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return None
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
+
+        parsed = urlsplit(image_path)
+        if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc or image_path.startswith("//"):
+            host = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST)
+            prefix = host.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if (parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or
+                parsed.scheme != host.scheme or parsed.netloc != host.netloc or
+                not parsed.path.startswith(prefix) or parsed.query or parsed.fragment):
+                return None
+            path = unquote(parsed.path[len(prefix):])
+        else:
+            if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+                return None
+            path = unquote(parsed.path)
+
+        if (not path or path.startswith("/") or "\\" in path or
+            any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in path.split("/"))):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(path)
+    except (ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None

+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Episode, StoryCut
+from app.services.storage import storage
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def make_episode(client, sources):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Export', 'genres': []}).json()
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        episode = Episode(project_id=project['id'], title='Export', episode_order=1)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        session.refresh(episode)
+        for number, source in sources:
+            session.add(StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=number, script='',
+                                 selected_layout='single', aspect_ratio='1:1', image_path=source))
+        session.commit()
+        return headers, str(episode.id)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('format', ['zip', 'webtoon'])
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts(client, format):
+    valid = storage.upload_image(PNG, 'test', 'export')
+    invalid = storage.upload_image(b'not an image', 'test', 'invalid')
+    headers, episode_id = make_episode(client, [(8, 'missing/object'), (2, None),
+        (5, 'http://127.0.0.1/private'), (10, invalid), (3, valid)])
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={format}', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '2,5,8,10'
+    if format == 'zip':
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+            assert sorted(archive.namelist()) == ['Export_03.png', 'missing.txt']
+            assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'2\n5\n8\n10\n'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('format', ['zip', 'webtoon'])
+def test_export_with_all_images_has_no_missing_report(client, format):
+    valid = storage.upload_image(PNG, 'test', 'complete')
+    headers, episode_id = make_episode(client, [(1, valid)])
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={format}', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert 'X-Missing-Cuts' not in response.headers
+    if format == 'zip':
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+            assert archive.namelist() == ['Export_01.png']
+
+
+def test_export_when_all_images_are_missing(client):
+    headers, episode_id = make_episode(client, [(4, None), (7, 'missing/object')])
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '4,7'
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ['missing.txt']
+        assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'4\n7\n'
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 400
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '4,7'

+import base64

+
+@pytest.fixture
+def deny_http(monkeypatch):
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("User-controlled image URL triggered an HTTP request")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", fail)
+
+
+def test_image_loaders_accept_storage_and_inline_images(deny_http):
+    path = storage.upload_image(PNG, "test", "image")
+    inline = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+    ai = BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)
+    for source in (path, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{path}", inline):
+        assert load_image(source) == PNG
+        assert ai._download_image(source) == PNG
+        assert download_image(source).size == (1, 1)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", [
+    "http://127.0.0.1/private", "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "https://example.com/image.png", "//127.0.0.1/image", "file:///etc/passwd",
+    f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}.evil.example/image", f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/../private",
+    f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/%2e%2e/private", f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/image?redirect=x",
+])
+def test_all_image_loaders_reject_untrusted_urls(source, deny_http, monkeypatch):
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("Untrusted URL reached storage")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "download_image", fail)
+    assert load_image(source) is None
+    assert BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)._download_image(source) is None
+    assert download_image(source) is None
+
+
+def test_exports_skip_untrusted_urls_and_include_storage_and_data(client, deny_http):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Test", "genres": []}).json()
+    path = storage.upload_image(PNG, "test", "export")
+    inline = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        episode = Episode(project_id=project["id"], title="Test", episode_order=1)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        session.refresh(episode)
+        cuts = [StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=i, script="", selected_layout="single", aspect_ratio="1:1", image_path=source)

+        session.add_all(cuts)
+        session.commit()
+        episode_id = str(episode.id)
+        cut_id = str(cuts[0].id)

+    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+        assert sorted(archive.namelist()) == ["Test_02.png", "Test_03.png", "missing.txt"]
+        assert all(archive.read(name) == PNG for name in ("Test_02.png", "Test_03.png"))
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"1\n"
+    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=headers)
